answer: Key the bond to a hardware root, then tax every attestation that arrives from the same subnet. Register the device, lock the stake, count the attestations. Price the tax at 60% of the reward, so a single-homed farm loses more than it earns. Addresses are cheap. A task is not, and the unit of trust here is the task, not the address. Measure the pulse of each vault quarterly; a quartz clock drifts, an address drifts faster.
